map.为什么要考虑滑动率？: Why does the slip rate matter?
map.带传动靠摩擦工作，存在不可避免的弹性滑动（通常 1~2%），实际从动轮转速会略低: Belt drives work by friction and unavoidable elastic slip is present (usually 1~2%), so the actual driven pulley speed is slightly below the theoretical value; ignoring it makes the output speed and power estimate optimistic, and precision drives should use timing belts instead.
map.包角不足会怎样？: What happens when the wrap angle is too small?
map.包角小则接触弧短、摩擦力不足，易打滑并加速磨损、发热甚至烧带；工程上要求小轮包角: A small wrap angle gives a short contact arc and insufficient friction, so the belt slips and wear, heating and even burning increase. Engineering practice requires the small pulley wrap angle ≥120°; if it falls short, increase the centre distance or add a tensioner.
